ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a large triangle containing three congruent circles. Two circles sit along the bottom, tangent to the base of the triangle and tangent to each other. A third circle sits above them, tangent to both lower circles. The left side of the triangle is tangent to the upper circle and the lower-left circle, while the right side is tangent to the upper circle and the lower-right circle. Reasoning: Each circle has radius 3, so when two circles are externally tangent, the distance between their centers is 3 + 3 = 6. Connecting the three circle centers forms an equilateral triangle of side length 6. Each side of the outer triangle is a common external tangent to two equal circles, so each outer side is parallel to the corresponding side of the center equilateral triangle. Thus the outer triangle is an outward parallel offset of the center equilateral triangle by distance 3. For an equilateral triangle, offsetting each side outward by distance d increases each side length by 2d cot(30°). With d = 3, each side of the outer triangle is 6 + 2(3)cot(30°) = 6 + 6√3. Therefore the perimeter is 3(6 + 6√3) = 18 + 18√3.

raw_record.question_text: Each of the three circles in the adjoining figure is externally tangent to the other two, and each side of the triangle is tangent to two of the circles. If each circle has radius three, what is the perimeter of the triangle?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as three congruent circles arranged with two on the bottom and one above, all pairwise externally tangent, inside a triangle whose base is tangent to the two lower circles, left side to the upper and lower-left circles, and right side to the upper and lower-right circles. From the text, each circle has radius 3, so the distance between any two circle centers is 6. Connect the three centers; they form an equilateral triangle of side 6. Since a common external tangent to two equal circles is parallel to the line through their centers, the three sides of the outer triangle are parallel to the three sides of this center triangle. Thus the outer triangle is an outward parallel offset of an equilateral triangle of side 6 by distance 3. For an equilateral triangle, offsetting each side outward by distance d increases each side length by 2d cot(30°). With d = 3, each side becomes 6 + 2(3)cot(30°) = 6 + 6sqrt(3). Multiply by 3 to get the perimeter 18 + 18sqrt(3).

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a symmetric triangular arrangement: two equal circles sit on the bottom side and one equal circle sits above them; the triangle sides are the outer common tangents to pairs of circles. From the text, each radius is 3, so tangent circle centers are 6 apart. Place coordinates on the centers: lower-left center at (0,0), lower-right at (6,0), and upper center at (3,3sqrt(3)), since the centers form an equilateral triangle. The bottom side of the outer triangle is the horizontal tangent line y = -3. The left side is the external tangent parallel to the segment from lower-left to upper center, whose slope is sqrt(3), and lying outside the circles at perpendicular distance 3 from those two centers. Similarly write the right side as the symmetric external tangent. Solve for the intersections of these three tangent lines; the bottom two intersections give the base length, or equivalently compute one full side. This yields side length 6 + 6sqrt(3), and because the three tangent lines have directions separated by 60°, the triangle is equilateral. Therefore the perimeter is 3(6 + 6sqrt(3)) = 18 + 18sqrt(3).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个大三角形，内部有三个相同大小的圆；两个圆位于底边上方并分别与底边相切，第三个圆位于它们上方。三个圆两两外切，三角形的每条边都分别与其中两个圆相切，整体呈对称的等边三角形布局。

推理：每个圆半径为3，所以任意两个相切圆的圆心距离为6。设下方左圆圆心为(0,0)，下方右圆圆心为(6,0)。上方圆圆心与两者距离都为6，因此三个圆心构成边长6的等边三角形，上方圆圆心为(3,3√3)。底边是两个下方圆的公共外切线，故为y=-3。左侧边是下方左圆与上方圆的外公切线，且与这两个圆心连线平行，斜率为√3，设为y=√3x+b。它到圆心(0,0)的距离为3，所以|b|/√(1+3)=|b|/2=3，得|b|=6。取左外侧切线为y=√3x+6。它与底边y=-3相交时，-3=√3x+6，所以x=-3√3。由对称性，右侧边与底边交点的x坐标为6+3√3。因此三角形底边长为(6+3√3)-(-3√3)=6+6√3。三条边方向相差60°，所以外三角形是等边三角形，每边长6+6√3。周长为3(6+6√3)=18+18√3。
